authority.source: Direct researcher instruction from Abdulla dated 2026-08-08
authority.purpose: Determine whether the unchanged evaluator executes correctly, reproducibly and materially faster on Colab G4 Blackwell with the current stable officially supported JAX CUDA-13 stack.

software_intervention.only_intended_intervention: JAX/CUDA execution stack required for Blackwell compatibility
software_intervention.source_change_rule: If the pinned evaluator or vec_jax requires any API/source modification, stop before evaluator execution and treat it as a separate intervention.

execution.backend_only_environment_difference: JAX_PLATFORMS selects CUDA rather than the validated CPU backend; all scientific environment variables remain identical.

operations: small float32 JAX array placed on GPU
same jitted operation second synchronized warm execution
primitive_gate.failure_action: Retain error, run zero evaluator processes, retrieve evidence and stop G4 session.

each_repeat_must_pass: offered tasks equal admitted plus every rejection and unavailability outcome
V2I offered service work equals admitted plus rejected or unavailable work
vehicle offered service work equals admitted plus rejected work
every active task has exactly one terminal outcome
counts, work, latency and queues nonnegative
offered and admitted deadline denominators remain separate
validation_contract.g4_repeat_contract: Exact scientific JSON equality excluding wall time and exact dtype/shape/byte SHA-256 identity for every instrumentation array.

floating_tolerance.meaning: Cross-backend continuous numerical fields need not be byte-identical, but every difference is reported and must be within this predeclared tolerance.

comparison_contract.material_divergence_rule: Any exact count/decision/terminal-outcome failure, any floating array outside tolerance, or any summary field outside tolerance is scientifically material and rejects G4 for this campaign gate.

performance_rule.measure: Median evaluator-reported wall time across two separate ten-step processes; each process includes its own compilation. Primitive first-versus-warm JIT timing is reported separately.
performance_rule.campaign_if_g4_selected: 15 full cells: fleet seeds 0-4 by caps 0.75x, 2.5x and 40x on one frozen G4 stack
performance_rule.ten_step_extrapolation_limit: A ten-step timing is compilation-heavy and only a provisional full-campaign planning estimate.

backend_decision_rule.g4_scientifically_acceptable_if: Primitive gate, both repeat validations, exact G4 repeat, cross-backend discrete identity and all floating tolerances pass with no unexplained material divergence.
backend_decision_rule.recommend_g4_if: G4 is scientifically acceptable and median speedup is at least 1.25x.
backend_decision_rule.if_g4_recommended: Do not launch. First update and hash-freeze the campaign manifest and RESEARCH_NEXT; run all 15 seed/cap full cells on the same G4 stack and do not reuse macOS seed-0 full outputs.
backend_decision_rule.if_g4_fails_or_is_not_worthwhile: Stop G4 experimentation and recommend the already validated macOS CPU backend; do not launch until its campaign selection is separately recorded.

output.checksum_policy: Retain SHA-256 and size for the bundle, pip install report, hardware and primitive evidence, every evaluator output, validation, comparison, log and downloaded archive.
output.failure_retention: Retain every failed or negative output and stop without overwrite.

stop_conditions: CLI status is not G4 or the in-runtime device is not a genuine NVIDIA GPU
any input, runner, CPU reference, lock or package identity differs
a nightly or unpinned package is present
any evaluator or vec_env scientific source change is required
any primitive operation fails or does not execute on the G4
either evaluator process exits nonzero or exceeds 10 steps
either repeat fails task or work conservation
G4 repeats differ scientifically or in instrumentation identity
cross-backend exact task stream, decision, terminal outcome or count differs
a numerical difference exceeds the predeclared tolerance
any full E1 or E2 process would start
a private artifact would enter Git or be published

authorised: exact package installation and immutable pip report
two serial ten-step corrected-physical evaluator repeats only
CPU comparison, evidence retrieval, reporting and session termination
prohibited: scientific queue, actor, trace, cap, placement, service or scaling changes
modifying or pushing vec_env or tos-data
E2, retraining, prediction or bus modelling
rewriting the prior failed G4 record
